parent_goal: Accept an ordinary user request and use the smallest sufficient combination of AI reasoning, direct answering, research, reuse, prompts, code, files, tools, verification, and limited replanning to produce the fastest high-quality usable result while preserving the user's actual goal and constraints.
non_goals: increasing the number of agents or model calls as an end in itself
promoting a single-domain experiment to the default product without cross-domain evidence
invariants: The user's parent goal and fixed constraints remain traceable through execution.
The system selects the smallest sufficient route or tool combination instead of requiring the user to design the workflow.
Model claims are distinguished from verified external or workspace results.
A failed or incomplete result is not presented as completed or recommended.
A retry changes one material dimension and is bounded unless the user explicitly authorizes more work.
Domain tools remain optional and cannot redefine the PSOS parent goal.
Weak continuation language continues only the recorded current task and never silently expands scope.

current_task.objective: Connect a persisted, domain-neutral stepwise Controller session to the ChatGPT manual execution path so manual and automatic execution can share goal state, bounded next-action selection, observable completion checks, and honest partial termination while differing only in how an action is transported to an AI engine.
explicitly_out_of_scope: promoting the Controller to the canonical default runtime
deep integration with ChatGPT project memory or account memory
allowing more than four manual AI actions or more than one material method change
claiming that the first manual session implementation already proves full general capability
completion_conditions: A persisted Controller session supports start, action-result submission, optional user-input resumption, completion, blocked and honest partial states.
The session owns the goal, fixed constraints, evidence, unresolved gaps, action history, action budget and one method-change budget.
A shared domain-neutral Action Packet and Action Result contract uses canonical PSOS routes rather than shopping or candidate-specific vocabulary.
The manual ChatGPT adapter exposes only the Controller-selected current action, imports the structured result, and asks the Controller for the next state.
The manual UI shows exactly one of current action, user question, completed result, blocked result or bounded partial result.
The existing one-shot Job Packet remains available as a hidden fallback but is no longer the primary manual flow.
Focused tests cover DIRECT completion, RESEARCH gap closing, one route change, duplicate-action blocking, user-input resumption, persistence and HTTP adapter behavior.
CI passes JavaScript checks, goal guard, focused tests and the full repository suite.

continuation_policy.meaning: Continue only the current_task within its allowed change classes and explicit scope.
requires_explicit_approval: promoting DOMAIN or TEST work into CORE
enabling an experimental path by default
expanding to a new domain-specific implementation

requirements: The same domain-neutral interface is used across the evidence cases.
At least four distinct domains show a measurable improvement or correct route decision.
No single domain supplies more than half of the passing evidence.
The change does not require domain vocabulary in the core interface.
Failure and partial states remain visible.
Default enablement is separately and explicitly approved by the user.
